Maria L.: Heads up — the candidate for Senior Infra moved their calendar to 3:30pm PST. Our panel was scheduled at 2pm. Can anyone swap into 2pm so I can join 3:30? :slightly_smiling_face:

Kevin T.: I can switch from 2 -> 3:30, no prob. Who needs the 2pm slot?

Ashley P.: @Kevin T. thanks! I can cover at 2pm if Kevin takes 3:30. Confirming I can do the system design portion.

Sam R.: I actually have a deploy at 2:15 that I can't move. Happy to do async notes if you need me, but can't take the 2pm panel.

Maria L.: Ok locking Kevin -> 3:30, Ashley -> 2pm. Sam, please leave rapid notes in the debrief doc if you can. Elaine, is 24h post-interview still the ask for notes?

Elaine (Talent): Yep — please post short debrief snippets to the candidate page within 24h. If you can't make the live debrief, mark "async" and paste key takeaways. Link: https://docs.internal/recruiting/debriefs

Ashley P.: Quick rubric Q: for Senior roles, when we grade system design do we prioritize depth (edge-case tradeoffs) or breadth (multiple components)? I saw both referenced in the rubric and want to be consistent.

Kevin T.: Short answer: depth > breadth for Senior Infra. We bias toward deep reasoning about a core component. Use this breakdown as a cheat-sheet:

```
Depth: 0-4 (how well they dig into core failure modes)
Breadth: 0-3 (coverage of multiple components)
Product/Tradeoffs: 0-2 (practical tradeoffs and deployment considerations)
Total: 0-9
```

Kevin T.: If in doubt, penalize lack of depth more than lack of breadth. Also call out any major unknowns in a bullet under "Assumptions" in the debrief doc.

Maria L.: Another minor ask — if you saw any code-review style habits during the take-home discussion (e.g., testing, safety checks), call them out under "Engineering Habits". One-liners fine.

Sam R.: Got it. I'll add: testing focus, clear abstractions, and note on telemetry suggestion.

Interview Bot: Calendar updated: Kevin T. moved to 3:30pm PST; Ashley P. at 2:00pm PST. Candidate invite refreshed. :white_check_mark:

Elaine (Talent): Thanks everyone — I'll send a short reminder with the debrief link right after the loop. If anyone wants to swap again ping here or DM me. :pray:
